end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from where it is grown or made to the plate.
Identified local food as travelling fewer food miles and compared apples from Shimla with spinach from near Delhi.
Explained that longer distances can use more fuel and that local food may be fresher.
Described cold storage, special packaging and refrigerated trucks as increasing energy use, waste and cost.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and comparing local and distant food using examples and cause-and-effect explanations. They explained that longer journeys can use more fuel, while local food may be fresher; the early brief answer “far food” was clarified later with a full definition. At home, ask Rohan to compare two foods and name their likely distance, fuel use and freshness.
